fields.name: magic
fields.meaning: The letters "KW". Checked at power-on; if missing the game wipes save memory 0000-1FFF and starts as a first-time player (tip MEMO_001, then asks for a name)
fields.evidence: power-on check 4000:0102-0104, wipe 4000:010c-0121; blank-vs-saved boot comparison

fields.name: player name
fields.meaning: Player name, 4 characters of 2 bytes each (example save: "なななな"; character code 0x0030 = な). A cancelled character is stored as 0
fields.evidence: store 4000:1a4a-1a5f from RAM 03F0 after name entry; power-on load 4000:0bef into RAM 03F0; save diffs across name entry; title and match screens show the name

fields.name: player level
fields.encoding: u8 (level-1; RAM bit 7 masked off on store)
fields.meaning: Player level shown on the title menu; 0 = LEVEL 1. Higher levels unlock menu items and records (code checks raw values 3, 5, 7, 9)
fields.evidence: store 6000:19e7 RAM 0120 AND 7F; power-on load 4000:0c0e; example save value 0 with LEVEL 1 on screen

fields.name: level progress
fields.meaning: Second level/progress value saved with the level (RAM 0121); exact meaning not established

fields.name: best score, match type A
fields.meaning: Best final score in a type A match, in hundreds of points; a new best is staged at 0139 and moved here when announced (needs raw level 3+)

fields.name: best score, match type B
fields.meaning: Same as 000C for match type B

fields.name: record 2, type A
fields.meaning: Best value ever of the 0120 counter in type A matches; kept as a max (pending announcement at 013F)
fields.evidence: max-keep 6000:1a52-1a76 vs SRAM 0120; shown on records screen from level 5 (4000:12b3)

fields.name: record 2, type B
fields.meaning: Same as 0010 for match type B

fields.name: record 3, type A
fields.meaning: Best value ever of the 0122 BCD counter in type A matches; kept as a max (pending announcement at 0143)
fields.evidence: max-keep 6000:1aa2-1aaf vs SRAM 0122; shown from level 7 (4000:1342)

fields.name: record 3, type B
fields.meaning: Same as 0012 for match type B

fields.name: option value
fields.meaning: A setting copied to RAM 012D at power-on; a new player starts with 7

fields.name: tip pages seen
fields.meaning: One byte per numbered tip page (MEMO_001..MEMO_100): 1 = already shown. Page n is at 0015+n-1. A new player starts with pages 1 and 5 marked
fields.evidence: mark 6000:22e8, test 6000:22f8-230b, count-all 6000:280e; diffs when tips MEMO_002/006/013-016/019-022/026 shown; boot read

fields.name: kept-hand slot status
fields.meaning: Status of the 4 kept-hand slots: 2 = empty (new player), 1 = in use; 0 = cleared on one level-up path

fields.name: kept-hand slot titles
fields.encoding: u16le game character codes x8, x4
fields.meaning: A name of 8 game characters for each of the 4 kept-hand slots (16 bytes per slot); never filled in any save so far

fields.name: table, match type A
fields.meaning: Six 2-byte values read by index on a records/opponent screen (not identified); zero in all saves

fields.name: table, match type B
fields.meaning: Same layout as 00BD for match type B; zero in all saves

fields.name: unknown
fields.meaning: No reader or writer found; zero in every save
fields.evidence: save diffs over the full play history all zero

fields.name: last menu choice, type A
fields.meaning: Menu choice last used in a type A match, restored at power-on

fields.name: last menu choice, type B
fields.meaning: Same as 0119 for match type B

fields.name: setting 011B
fields.meaning: A setting read and written by one menu (not identified)

fields.name: setting 011C
fields.meaning: A setting read and written by one menu (not identified)

fields.name: unknown
fields.meaning: No access found; zero in every save
fields.evidence: save diffs over the full play history

fields.name: progress pair 011E
fields.meaning: Two per-type progress values compared against 2..8 by menu logic (not identified); zero in all saves

fields.name: progress counters
fields.meaning: Two per-type counters; the running value whose best is kept at 0010/0011. The type A counter at 0120 gates a level-up event at value 2 (level up, tip pages marked, 0124 cleared); zero in all saves

fields.name: streak counters
fields.meaning: Two per-type BCD counters; the running value whose best is kept at 0012/0013. +1 (decimal) per finished match once past level 7, capped at 99; reset to 0 when RAM 01A7 is nonzero (so probably a win streak); zero in all saves

fields.name: progress 0124
fields.meaning: Cleared (set 0) on the 0120 level-up path (not identified); zero in all saves

fields.name: turn counter, type A
fields.meaning: Turn number in the current hand of a type A match (example: 3 while the screen says 3巡目). Cleared when a hand starts, +1 each turn
fields.evidence: clear 6000:2b57/2b70, add 6000:2b7f-2ba8 with decimal adjust, read 6000:2bac-2bbe; diffs follow the on-screen turn count

fields.name: turn counter, type B
fields.meaning: Same as 0125 for match type B; zero in all saves

fields.name: match block A1
fields.meaning: Four 2-byte values from RAM 018A saved at the end of a type A hand (not identified); zero in all saves

fields.name: match block B1
fields.meaning: Same as 0127 for match type B; zero in all saves

fields.name: match byte A/B
fields.meaning: One byte per match type copied from RAM 04E6 (not identified); zero in all saves

fields.name: new best score pending, type A
fields.meaning: 0x80 + score when a new best is waiting to be announced; moved to 000C and cleared later; zero in all saves

fields.name: new best score pending, type B
fields.meaning: Same as 0139 for match type B; zero in all saves

fields.name: record 2 pending flags
fields.meaning: Pending-announcement flags (0x80) and values for the 0010/0011 records; zero in all saves

fields.name: record 3 pending flags
fields.meaning: Pending-announcement flags (0x80) and values for the 0012/0013 records; zero in all saves

fields.name: match scores, type A
fields.meaning: Live scores of the four players in the type A match being played, in hundreds of points (example: 25000 each, as on the continue screen)
fields.evidence: save 6000:2bdf-2bf6 from RAM 019B-01A6, load 6000:2c36-2c4d; boot reads; continue screen

fields.name: match state, type A
fields.meaning: Four bytes of match state from RAM 012F-0132 (probably round/wind data); zero in the observed matches

fields.name: match byte, type A
fields.meaning: One byte from RAM 04A6 (not identified); zero in the observed matches

fields.name: unknown
fields.meaning: No access found; zero in every save
fields.evidence: save diffs over the full play history

fields.name: match scores, type B
fields.meaning: Same as 0147 for match type B; zero in all saves
fields.evidence: save 6000:2bbf (block at 0159 for type B), load 6000:2c33

fields.name: match state, type B
fields.meaning: Same as 0153 for match type B; zero in all saves

fields.name: match bytes, type B
fields.meaning: First byte as 0157 for match type B; the second byte's use was not seen

fields.name: match byte from RAM 014D
fields.meaning: One byte per match type from RAM 014D (not identified); zero in all saves

fields.name: value pair 016D
fields.meaning: Two values written and read by one menu (not identified)

fields.name: flag 016F
fields.meaning: Set to 0x80 and cleared around a match start (not identified)

fields.name: seat value
fields.meaning: A random seat value 0-3 dealt into the next match setup (middle opponent slot)

fields.name: opponent data, type A
fields.meaning: Five bytes from RAM 0162-0166 plus one from RAM 04E6, saved per match type (not identified); zero in all saves

fields.name: opponent data, type B
fields.meaning: Same as 0171 for match type B; zero in all saves

fields.name: unknown
fields.meaning: No access found; zero in every save
fields.evidence: save diffs over the full play history

fields.name: work memory (task slots)
fields.meaning: Not save data: four 64-byte slots where the game parks running tasks
fields.evidence: swap 4000:059f-05d4 between SRAM 0200+64*n and RAM 0400; changes every few frames during play

fields.name: work memory (screen backup)
fields.meaning: Not save data: copy of the background tile map kept while a window is open; 0340-04FF is also cleared at power-on

fields.name: work memory (sprite backup)
fields.meaning: Not save data: copy of the sprite table (RAM 0880-097F)

fields.name: suspend valid, type A
fields.meaning: 1 = a suspended type A hand exists; drives the continue offer (続きから)
fields.evidence: write 6000:2dea, power-on load 4000:0c51 into RAM 07E8, continue check 4000:3179; blank-vs-saved boot comparison

fields.name: game step at suspend
fields.meaning: Game sequence step when the hand was saved (RAM 0480); 4 while a hand is in progress, 0 before the deal. The continue screen checks values 0, 4, 14h, 18h
fields.evidence: snapshot table entry 0 (5000:F1F0), read 4000:5018/52a2; boot read; value 4 in every in-hand save, 0 pre-deal

fields.name: opponents
fields.meaning: The three computer opponents of the match (RAM 0491-0493, from the chosen opponents at RAM 012A-012C); the continue screen names three pros
fields.evidence: setup 4000:3193-31a4 (reversed copy) and 4000:31ce-31f9; snapshot table entry 1; restore at boot; continue screen shows three opponent names

fields.name: random value 1
fields.meaning: Random 0-3 drawn when the hand starts (RAM 04B0; probably the dice or start seat)

fields.name: random value 2
fields.meaning: Random 0-3 drawn when the hand starts (RAM 04B2); in replay mode restored from RAM 077B instead

fields.name: seat order
fields.meaning: Seating order: 0,1,2,3 shuffled by 64 random swaps (RAM 0494-0497); a fresh shuffle each hand
fields.evidence: init+shuffle 4000:3205-3247; two different permutations seen across saves (03 00 01 02, then 00 01 02 03)

fields.name: match byte (RAM 012E)
fields.meaning: Match setting from RAM 012E (not identified)

fields.name: match type
fields.meaning: Match type of the suspended hand (RAM 0122: 0 = type A); selects slot 0C00/0F00/1E00

fields.name: scores at hand start
fields.meaning: Four players scores when the hand began, in hundreds of points (example: 25000 each)
fields.evidence: snapshot table entry 7 (RAM 019B-01A6); init 4000:31a8-31b2; continue screen

fields.name: round bytes
fields.meaning: Three bytes from RAM 0127-0129 (probably round, dealer-repeat and deposit counts); zero in the observed matches

fields.name: hand byte (RAM 0484)
fields.meaning: Hand state from RAM 0484 (not identified); zero in the observed matches

fields.name: hand bytes (RAM 048A)
fields.meaning: Hand state from RAM 048A-048B (not identified); zero in the observed matches

fields.name: hand byte (RAM 04A6)
fields.meaning: Hand state from RAM 04A6 (not identified); zero in the observed matches

fields.name: hand byte (RAM 04EA)
fields.meaning: Hand state from RAM 04EA (not identified); zero in the observed matches

fields.name: hand bytes (RAM 012F)
fields.meaning: Hand state from RAM 012F-0132 (not identified); zero in the observed matches

fields.name: hand byte (RAM 04E9)
fields.meaning: Hand state from RAM 04E9 (not identified); zero in the observed matches

fields.name: tile wall
fields.meaning: All 136 tiles of the hand in shuffled draw order. Codes 01-09, 11-19, 21-29 are the three suits 1-9, 31-37 the honour tiles; each code appears 4 times
fields.evidence: shuffle 4000:a652 via ROM table 5000:EED8 (verified 34 codes x4); snapshot table entry 17; every wall is a permutation of that multiset

fields.name: wall end mark
fields.meaning: Always FF, ends the wall
fields.evidence: write 4000:a65f; snapshot table entry 17; FF in every dealt hand

fields.name: turn log
fields.encoding: u8 x8 per record, FFFF end
fields.meaning: Log of the turns played since the hand started: 8-byte records back to back (first record usually 07 02 02 00..., later ones 07 02 0D 80... with occasional 00 FF 0D 80...), ended by FF FF; the rest of the slot is zero. Replayed on continue to rebuild the hand. Record bytes are game values from RAM 041D, 0418, 0415, 04E6, 042F, 0416, 014B, 014C (meaning of each not identified)
fields.evidence: append 4000:7de2-7e31 (pointer RAM 07EC), FFFF init 4000:36b1, replay read 4000:7e36; log grows 1-2 records per played segment (0, 1, 2 ... 12 records seen)

fields.name: suspend slot, type B
fields.meaning: Same layout as 0C00-0EFF for a type B match; empty in every save

fields.name: kept hands 1-4
fields.meaning: Four kept-hand copies of 0x300 bytes each (1200, 1500, 1800, 1B00): a whole suspend slot copied when the player keeps a hand under a title (see 0079/007D); replayed later. Empty in every save

fields.name: replay slot
fields.meaning: Suspend slot used while a kept hand is being replayed (RAM 0123 set). Only 0x200 bytes fit before the chip end; the turn log is never written here (append skips replay mode)

fields.name: outside the chip
fields.meaning: The cartridge has 8 KB of save memory; bytes past 1FFF are not on the chip (the file is padded)
fields.evidence: ROM header save type 01 (64 Kbit); wipe covers 0000-1FFF only (4000:010c-0121)

fields.name: console owner data
fields.meaning: Not written by this game: the console owner profile; identical in the blank and in every save
fields.evidence: byte-identical across blank and all saves

values.value: none: save is protected by the magic 'KW' only
